notes.title: End of Summer Benefit Sale Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049196/c452731e782cc7d0d229eb6a5a4d675916976de7.png[/img]
Hey there again you lovely people! 

The next few days are going to be really special for us, as we’ve teamed-up with the amazing folks from [b]One Gamer Fund[/b] and have put our entire library of Good Shepherd Entertainment published titles on sale for the lowest prices each respective title has ever been available for here on Steam to benefit the One Gamer Fund during its inaugural charity weekend.

The One Gamer Fund is a new philanthropic initiative comprised of seven gaming nonprofits: [b]AbleGamers[/b], [b]Child’s Play[/b], [b]Games for Change[/b], [b]Global Game Jam[/b], [b]the IGDA Foundation[/b], [b]Stack-Up[/b] and [b]Take This[/b]. Between [b]10 a.m. PT on Sept. 21 to 10 a.m. PT on Sept. 25[/b], [i]half of all proceeds[/i] generated by purchases of Good Shepherd games after Steam’s share of revenue is factored will be donated directly to the IGDA Foundation on behalf of the One Gamer Fund and subsequently dispersed among all partnering nonprofits.

This is not all though! We’ve also just launched a special new [b]Good Shepherd Entertainment Bundle[/b] to coincide with this sale. This bundle will allow those whom already own some of our games to easily complete their set at a special additional [b]25% discount[/b]! This means that you can add even more gaming goodness to life whilst helping these seven amazing charities and causes. 

A number of Twitch personalities will also be hosting special streams to aid the One Gamer Fund throughout the weekend. Individuals can learn more about ways to participate by visiting www.OneGamerFund.org and following @OneGamerFund on Twitter.

We can’t tell you guys how much this sales means to us and how proud we are to be a small part of helping these amazing causes. None of this would be possible without all of your help though, so on behalf of everyone involved in this benefit sale, we just wanted to say thank you very much for your continued support! 

Here’s to the power of gaming!

Greetings,

The Good Shepherd Team

notes.title: Trading Cards!
notes.content:
A special set of Trading Cards has been added to Mutant Mudds Deluxe!

There are eight awesome Trading Cards in total, which contribute to six wonderful Badges through crafting complete Trading Card sets!
[list]
[*]Max Boost
[*]Skeyes
[*]Royal Mudd
[*]Slammer Hammer
[*]Pork Plop
[*]Grannie
[*]Devil Cat Ball
[*]Ditsy Drop
[/list]
And, don't forget: there are also five Emoticons and three Background images to be had!

Happy hunting / trading!

notes.title: Joypad Support
notes.content:
Yes, this game does support joypads. Hooray for buttons! You may need to access "Control Configuration" to set yours up. Here's how:

[list]
In Window View (press Alt+Enter if in Fullscreen View) go to the 'Options' pull-down menu.
Select 'Control Configuration'.
[/list]

The 'Control Configuration' panel provides many control options for you to choose or adjust.

Hope this helps. Happy blasting!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Mutant Mudds Deluxe, 10% off!
notes.content:
Mutant Mudds Deluxe is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

Love pixels? Fond of platformers? Is there a special place in your heart for the 8-bit and 16-bit era? Want to have fun? Yes!? Well, you’ve come to the right place, my friend. Mutant Mudds Deluxe is a “12-bit” action platformer full of pixels and platforming fun!

Our hero, Max, may be just a 2D sprite, but he can leap into the third dimension by jetting between the background and the foreground playfields with his trusty jetpack in this unique dimensionally-woven experience.

Armed with a heavy-duty water cannon, Max has what he needs to vanquish his long-term nemesis: the Mutant Mudds. Max must blast and hover his way across the soiled landscape to seek out mysterious Water Sprites. Legend says collecting all of the mysterious Water Sprites will wash the filthy Mutant Mudds away for good!
*Offer ends November 28 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Mutant Mudds Deluxe Launching on Nov 21, 2013
notes.content:
[b]* UPDATE: The game is launching sooner! Nov 21, 2013 *[/b]

It has been a long road! After 369 days on Steam Greenlight, Mutant Mudds Deluxe was Greenlit for release on Steam.

A very special thank you to the many thousands of awesome players out there who helped get our game greenlit. The day is nearly here!

We're super excited to announce that the game will launch on [b]Nov 21[/b], 2013 for $9.99.

Steam Leaderboards and Steam Achievements are supported.
